## Dossiers

### Catalyzer

**Economic Impact Catalyst** · Chattanooga, US · Accelerator management platforms

- **Pricing.** Free version available; paid tiers request-demo
- **Scope.** cohort management, CRM, intake, session tracking, longitudinal impact surveys
- **What makes it different.** SOC 2 and WCAG 2.1 AA certified - the only certified competitor found
- **Where it is weak.** US federal/state funding-report framing; no India presence
- **Customer evidence.** `UNKNOWN` — none found
- **Source.** <https://www.catalyzerapp.com/accelerators> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `VERIFIED_LIVE`

### Dealum

**Dealum** · US · Accelerator management platforms

- **Pricing.** Essentials $119/mo · Advance $289/mo · Scale $479/mo (annual); higher monthly
- **Scope.** accelerator lifecycle: application to graduation to first round and exit
- **What makes it different.** Deal-room depth for investor-facing workflow
- **Where it is weak.** No India presence; no institutional/mandate features
- **Customer evidence.** `UNKNOWN` — none found
- **Source.** <https://dealum.com/pricing/accelerator> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `VERIFIED_LIVE`

### FIKR

**FIKR Space** · Lagos / global (Africa-anchored) · Accelerator management platforms

- **Pricing.** Free · Growth €149/mo · Scale €399/mo
- **Scope.** accelerator OS: applications, AI screening, cohorts, mentor matching, demo day, analytics
- **What makes it different.** Full white-label portal on Scale; genuine free tier
- **Where it is weak.** Africa-first assumptions; no India presence
- **Customer evidence.** `VENDOR_CLAIM` — 180+ countries access (network, not customers)
- **Source.** <https://fikr.space/accelerator> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `VERIFIED_LIVE`

### FosiaHub

**Fosia Ltd** · Africa (Kenya/Nigeria/Ghana ecosystem) · Accelerator management platforms

- **Pricing.** Hub $299/mo · Accelerator $799/mo · free 90-day pilot for institutions
- **Scope.** accelerator/development-agency programmes: AI scoring, cohorts, credits, donor reporting
- **What makes it different.** Donor/funder reporting and credits distribution - funder-shaped, not institution-shaped
- **Where it is weak.** Africa-first; no India presence
- **Customer evidence.** `VENDOR_CLAIM` — none found
- **Source.** <https://fosiahub.com/for-institutions> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `VERIFIED_LIVE`

### European Startup Hub

**European Startup Hub** · Europe · Startup ecosystem platforms

- **Pricing.** Institutional licence from €15,000/yr · Regional from €50,000/yr · Portal Cloud from €2,500 · Accelerator infrastructure from €12,000
- **Scope.** operating layer for university hubs and regional innovation networks
- **What makes it different.** THE ONLY institutional-licence model found - per licence, not per seat
- **Where it is weak.** Very high price point; Europe public-sector shaped; no India presence
- **Customer evidence.** `UNKNOWN` — Universities, accelerators, cities, government agencies (unnamed)
- **Source.** <https://www.europeanstartuphub.com/ecosystem-platform/> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `VERIFIED_LIVE`

### Elsevier Pure

**Elsevier** · Netherlands / UK · Innovation management platforms

- **Pricing.** UK G-Cloud list £19,406–£58,504/yr + £32,250 onboarding
- **Scope.** research outputs, funding, affiliations, impact - the research management benchmark
- **What makes it different.** The hardest price benchmark in the study; institutional-grade trust
- **Where it is weak.** Manages RESEARCH OUTPUTS, not startups; no India-specific module; very expensive
- **Customer evidence.** `UNKNOWN` — Universities and research institutions worldwide (generic - none named)
- **Source.** <https://www.elsevier.com/products/pure> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `PUBLISHED`

### Envisio

**Envisio Solutions Inc.** · US / Canada · Innovation management platforms

- **Pricing.** CONFLICT: GetApp USD 400/yr vs SelectHub USD 20,000/yr; observed contract USD 19,500/yr + USD 8,775 setup
- **Scope.** public-sector strategy + performance dashboards, unlimited user licences
- **What makes it different.** Serves ONLY public sector, nonprofit and education - closest buyer match outside India
- **Where it is weak.** Not a startup platform; no India presence; 50x aggregator conflict unresolved
- **Customer evidence.** `NAMED_REFERENCE` — City of La Mesa, CA (council resolution, USD 19,500/yr)
- **Source.** <https://envisio.com/pricing/> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `CONFLICT`

### IdeaScale

**IdeaScale** · San Francisco, US · Innovation management platforms

- **Pricing.** $4,999 per feature per year (aggregator); enterprise custom
- **Scope.** enterprise idea/innovation management, crowdsourcing, gamification, prioritisation
- **What makes it different.** Largest installed base in enterprise innovation; sold to government and academia
- **Where it is weak.** Corporate intrapreneurial; assumes employee base, SSO, IT dept; no Indian institution
- **Customer evidence.** `NAMED_LOGO` — White House, NASA, McKinsey, IKEA, Ford, Target, Pfizer
- **Source.** <https://ideascale.com/pricing/> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `AGGREGATOR`

### Incu (Sweden)

**Incu** · Sweden · Innovation management platforms

- **Pricing.** 790 kr/user/month
- **Scope.** innovation management with maturity levels and a patent data field
- **What makes it different.** THE ONLY competitor anywhere with any patent awareness - as a data field, not a workflow
- **Where it is weak.** A data field is not an IP workflow; no India presence
- **Customer evidence.** `UNKNOWN` — none found
- **Source.** <https://www.incuby.se/> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `AGGREGATOR`

### Throttle

**Relic Inc.** · Japan · Innovation management platforms

- **Pricing.** ¥980 / ¥1,980 / ¥2,980 / ¥3,980 per user per month, ex-tax

### Wazoku

**Wazoku** · UK · Innovation management platforms

- **Pricing.** Total Innovation License - $15,000 per Admin/year, unlimited end users
- **Scope.** innovation OS + Innocentive marketplace (1M members), xV value metric, ecosystem management
- **What makes it different.** Unlimited end users at a per-admin price - the correct shape for institutions
- **Where it is weak.** Priced at enterprise scale; no India presence; incumbent-ecosystem assumptions
- **Customer evidence.** `VENDOR_CLAIM` — none found
- **Source.** <https://www.wazoku.com/total-innovation-license/> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `PUBLISHED`

### SINT.OTRI

**SINT** · Palma de Mallorca, Spain · Tech transfer / IP management platforms (added by Phase 9)
